provenance_summary.reasoning: B-STR-YE-017 has both required pathway genes (B-GEN-AAT1, B-GEN-EHT1), producing EHEX/EBUT/EOCT at 42/31/18 mg/L (combined 91 mg/L, above 85 mg/L threshold). It has completed a 20L pilot run (B-RUN-FERM-033) under B-PROT-001 at low temperature with all QC checks passed. Strain bank is released with 42 cryovials at 96% viability. Bioreactor B-BR-R2 is available 2026-04-28 to 2026-05-10, allowing harvest by 2026-05-02 and QC release by 2026-05-04, well before the 2026-05-15 target.
secondary_candidates: B-STR-YE-021 (Yeast Citriflow 21) - bench validated but no pilot run, on hold pending scale-up review
insufficient_candidates: B-STR-YE-018 (Yeast BananaFlow 18) - produces banana profile (B-PROF-BANANA-04), not the citrus ester profile requested
